title: tc-configuration-release-control
description:
A configuration version moving through environments: the pipeline, what changed, the evaluation evidence, the
approvals, the rollout and the rollback target, with a gated, confirmed Promote and a confirmed Roll back.

description.description: A quieter line under the heading, e.g. which assistant this configures

stages.description: The environments in order, each with the version it runs and any rollout in progress

versions.description: Every version the stages, the candidate and the rollback target refer to

candidate.description: The id of the version being promoted

target.description: The id of the stage it's promoted to; unset, the stage after the last one that fully runs it

changes.description: What changed against the version it replaces, by area

evidence.description: The evaluation behind the promotion; unset, promotion waits for one

rollback.description: Where Roll back goes; unset, there's nothing to roll back to

hold.description: A reason that holds every promotion, e.g. "Releases are frozen until Monday"

promoteNote.description: Said in the promote confirmation, under the move

rollbackNote.description: Said in the rollback confirmation, under the move

suites.description: Gate suites and their results; unset, the gate doesn't ask for any

findings.description: Open findings linked to the candidate; blocking ones hold promotion unless waived

waivers.description: Waivers for conditional suites and blocking findings, with who granted them and when they expire

version.description: The id of the version it fully runs; unset when nothing is deployed

rollout.description: A rollout in progress: another version taking `percent` (0–100) of this stage's traffic

ReleaseStage.description: An environment a version moves through, in order

title.description: What it is, e.g. "Shorter refund answers"

ReleaseVersion.description: A configuration version: an immutable snapshot of instructions, model, tools and retrieval

count.description: How many changes, e.g. 3 edited lines or 2 tools added

detail.description: A quieter line, e.g. "2 added, 1 removed"

ReleaseChange.description: One area of the configuration that changed

detail.description: A quiet line, e.g. their role or when they approved

passed.description: Counts, shown as "5 passed · 2 failed · 1 inconclusive"

ReleaseSuite.description: A suite of checks the release gate runs, e.g. "Safety regression"

ReleaseSuiteStatus.description: A gate suite's result: pass, fail, or conditional – passing only on a waiver

suite.description: The id of the suite it came from

blocking.description: A blocking finding holds promotion until it's closed or waived

ReleaseFinding.description: An open finding linked to the candidate

covers.description: The ids of the suites and findings it covers

expires.description: When it expires, shown as given, e.g. "2026-06-10"

expired.description: The app says it has expired – it then counts as unmet

ReleaseWaiver.description: A waiver: lets a conditional suite or a blocking finding through until it expires
